annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/377 of 2 March 2021 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/436 on harmonised standards for machinery drafted in support of Directive 2006/42/EC
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/377 of 2 March 2021 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/436 on harmonised standards for machinery drafted in support of Directive 2006/42/EC
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 72/12
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Decision updating the list of harmonised machinery standards giving presumption of conformity under the Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC. It adds, amends and withdraws standard references, including industrial trucks and robotic lawnmowers, with withdrawals deferred to 3 September 2022. No AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends Annex I of Implementing Decision 2019/436 by adding new harmonised machinery standard references
Adds withdrawn superseded standards to Annex III with withdrawal date 3 September 2022
Includes standards for industrial trucks and robotic battery-powered lawnmowers (EN 50636-2-107)
Compliance with listed standards gives presumption of conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC
Enters into force on publication, 3 March 2021
